original_settings.prior: retained v70 means, original training quantiles/copy/broad support; no public-input networks
original_settings.likelihood: variance-matched multivariate t5 with peer moments and shared-flight covariance
original_settings.measurement: retained taxi2 covariance plus retained departure t3 scale converted to variance
original_settings.calendars: own local takeoff runway cell; own once-estimated UTC off-block day
original_settings.comparison: joint posterior mean minus matched departure-only moment posterior mean
original_settings.transfer: one fixed half incremental correction through current v77 constraints
original_settings.common_error: one shared15-second mean perturbation across the selected two cohorts
original_settings.scope: existing ambiguous Rome gap gate, original monthly quality gate, supported sources

robust_settings.prior: retained v70 means, original training quantiles/copy/broad support; no public-input networks
robust_settings.likelihood: variance-matched multivariate t5 with peer moments and shared-flight covariance
robust_settings.measurement: retained taxi2 covariance plus retained departure t3 scale converted to variance
robust_settings.calendars: own local takeoff runway cell; own once-estimated UTC off-block day
robust_settings.comparison: new_joint minus original_joint; original departure-only comparator unchanged
robust_settings.transfer: fixed0.5 additional increment on exactv78; separately frozen coefficient-one v79 transport
robust_settings.common_error: one shared15-second outer product over the bounded message, exact original3D marginal
robust_settings.scope: existing ambiguous Rome gap gate, original monthly quality gate, supported sources
robust_settings.additional: all supported same-local-day other runway taxi cells intersecting the assigned-day delay cohort; full taxi membership
robust_settings.conditioning: Gaussian Schur moments with one capped variance-matched t5 score weight; unchanged original 3D t5 target likelihood
robust_settings.robust_weight: min(1,(5+k)/(3+q)); q=r_B.T C_BB^-1 r_B, k=extra dimension
robust_settings.review_history: unexecuted 5+q denominator corrected to variance-matched 3+q before any robust prediction; no weight scan
robust_settings.caveat: hybrid approximation; unknown cross-runway source-error covariance and possible prior-error suppression
robust_settings.disconnected: exact recovery when the entire C_AB is zero; adding disconnected coordinates beside informative ones may change global q/k/weight

design.prior: Exact serialized v70 independently audited final view; retained old prior
design.assignments: Takeoff minus fixed v70 once; explicit interior days of each UTC takeoff month; exclude VFR
design.taxi: Original local takeoff day/runway, stand/runway eligibility, monthly invalid share strictly below0.05
design.source: Reuse complete cached parent taxi_source/delay_source, require all final months covered
design.calibration: Original saved full2025 taxi/delay/support parameters, exact original hashes; never refit
design.old: Reconstruct inputs exactly then reuse both retained posterior outputs; do not rerun
design.final: Original model.apply then unchanged robust.apply, separate per-month checkpoints
design.anchoring: robust.old_joint versus saved original finaljoint atol1e-8; anchor delta to saved joint, force zero for no extra cells
design.transfer: Export fulltemplate-ID increment and robust delta; half-weight/bounds/serialization only in later assembler
design.provenance: v70 final retains previously audited component reconstruction history
